fixtures.after:
The Scheduler keeps every pending job in a priority queue ordered by deadline. When a worker asks for work, the Scheduler hands out the job with the earliest deadline. It records the worker identity next to the job and starts a lease timer of 30 seconds for that assignment.

If the lease expires before the worker reports completion, the Scheduler returns the job to the queue and increments the RetryCount of the job. It refuses to hand the job to the same worker again until 2 other workers have asked for work. That keeps a single broken worker from starving one job. A job whose RetryCount reaches 5 moves to the dead-letter queue, where an operator can inspect it. The dead-letter queue is bounded at 1000 entries.
